statement_en:
Let $f(x)$ be a nonnegative locally integrable nonincreasing function on $[1,+\infty)$, and suppose
$$\int_1^{+\infty}f(x)\,dx=+\infty.$$ Then
$$\int_{1}^{+\infty}\min\{f(x),\frac{1}{x}\}\,dx=+\infty.$$
